note: Field lists below are copied verbatim from packages/contracts/tool_contracts/*.schema.json 'what_this_schema_cannot_express' blocks (Stage 11) and DDD domain_model.md SS7 -- not re-invented here.

scenarios.description: A well-formed reconciliation response for NCB204-B24071 with findings only, no disposition field.

Adversarial: a draft that snuck in a release_recommended field despite the schema not defining one (simulating a hand-crafted malformed payload, e.g. from a compromised upstream step) -- must be rejected by the guard, not just by schema absence.
Adversarial: response includes a 'reportability' field -- PV-Intake Agent's output schema must structurally exclude this (DDD SS10).

Adversarial: a ShortageOption carrying allocated_quantity -- must fail even though supply.generate_options's real contract has no such field; this scenario simulates a downstream synthesis step trying to add one.
human_review.required missing/false on a PV output -- must fail regardless of field content, since PV requires 100% routing.
